coil_assembly.basis: T03 nozzle_results.json C_W15 (T00 branch), scaled to V4 by the stand-off ratio; B 25 T at the winding surface

layers_PROTOTYPE.what: vacuum gap and multilayer insulation around the 20 K case
actively cooled 80 K shield (He gas) plus its gap
T03 warm eddy screen, cooled; takes the armour back-face re-radiation
low-conductance stand-offs carry the armour off the cryostat; robot tool clearance for segment exchange
tin channels in the armour back plate (the 1,800 K hot-loop fluid)
sacrificial plasma- and X-ray-facing tiles; material and thickness wait for T00 sec. 5

coil_assembly.note: the share uses the outermost layer of the full assembly (armour, which must shadow everything behind it); a share of sin(polar) * h / d is the band between polar +- h/d; the Blender ray cast (rev4_geometry.json raycast) checks it on the drawn mesh

coil_plant.basis: 300 K coolant rise, 5 m/s, six supply/return pairs per coil in the strut shadows, ring manifolds fed at six points (12 segments, so each manifold arc carries 1/12 of the flow), 1 MPa, Mo-TZM pipe at 50 MPa creep (all PROTOTYPE)

axis_kernel.use: multiply first_hit_fraction x bin_share_of_4pi x (escaping energy per unit solid angle in that bin x 4 pi) to get the energy on each part
